title: git worktree remove --force on a worktree holding a node_modules junction deleted the main checkout's node_modules through the junction
observation: Observed 2026-09-15 on Windows. To run tests in a temporary worktree without a second install, node_modules was linked as a directory junction (New-Item -ItemType Junction) to the main checkout's node_modules. `git worktree remove --force <path>` then removed the worktree recursively and followed the junction: the main checkout was left with an empty node_modules (0 entries), the source CLI failed with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for commander, and a post-commit hook in another worktree failed silently for the same reason. Restored with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` (108 entries). Rule for future sessions and for any tooling that creates worktrees: delete the junction first (`cmd /c rmdir <wt>\node_modules`, which removes the link, not the target) or install separately; never recurse-delete a directory that contains a junction to shared state.
